articles.title: “This is Maharashtra!” – MNS Workers Slap Restaurant Owner for Not Speaking Marathi in Viral Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Mumbai – In a shocking incident from Mira Road, a restaurant owner was slapped multiple times by Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS) workers for not speaking in Marathi. A video of the assault has gone viral, sparking widespread outrage and debate on linguistic imposition.

body.html:
Mumbai – In a shocking incident from Mira Road, a restaurant owner was slapped multiple times by Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS) workers for not speaking in Marathi. A video of the assault has gone viral, sparking widespread outrage and debate on linguistic imposition.

The altercation began when three MNS workers confronted the owner, asking why he wasn’t using Marathi. The owner responded, “I didn’t know Marathi was compulsory. Someone will have to teach me,” which triggered anger. After a heated exchange, one of the workers slapped him repeatedly in full public view.

While some defended the promotion of Marathi, many condemned the use of violence. Police have taken cognisance of the incident; no formal complaint has been filed yet.

articles.title: Young Kabaddi Star Dies of Rabies After Puppy Bite – Ignored Vaccine, Paid With Life!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bulandshahr, UP – Promising kabaddi player Brajesh Solanki tragically died from rabies after neglecting treatment for a dog bite. A resident of Farana village near Khurja, Brajesh was training for state-level competitions and aimed for Pro Kabaddi League selection.

body.html:
Bulandshahr, UP – Promising kabaddi player Brajesh Solanki tragically died from rabies after neglecting treatment for a dog bite. A resident of Farana village near Khurja, Brajesh was training for state-level competitions and aimed for Pro Kabaddi League selection.

In March, he rescued a puppy from a drain and was bitten on his finger. Considering it a minor wound, he did not take the rabies vaccine and continued with training. In late June, he developed numbness, chills, and paralysis. He was taken to hospitals in Aligarh, Mathura, and finally Delhi’s GTB Hospital, where doctors confirmed rabies. It was too late for treatment. He died on the way back home.

His sudden death has shocked the sports community and underlined the life-threatening danger of ignoring rabies after a dog bite.

articles.title: Inspector’s Son Wields Rifle in Towel, Threatens Neighbour in Varanasi – Video Goes Viral!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Varanasi, UP – A shocking video from Varanasi has gone viral, allegedly showing a police inspector’s son threatening his neighbour with a rifle during a heated altercation.

body.html:
Varanasi, UP – A shocking video from Varanasi has gone viral, allegedly showing a police inspector’s son threatening his neighbour with a rifle during a heated altercation.

The video captures the youth, dressed in just a vest and towel, angrily rushing at his neighbour with a rifle in hand. During the scuffle, his towel slips, leaving him in underwear as he continues hurling abuses and issuing life threats. A woman with the neighbour is seen bravely confronting the armed man, while another semi-naked man tries to intervene.

The incident took place in a residential locality, and the victim’s family recorded the video on a mobile phone. Following public outrage, police have registered a case and initiated an investigation.
